name: Aureon Global — US real estate 7-step (Hormozi style)
target: US real estate agents and small brokerages
voice_notes: Hormozi style: specific concrete numbers, dream outcome leads, risk reversal in every step, anchor against the alternative.
No hedging language. No 'just', 'maybe', 'kinda', 'I think'. Direct.
Strong CTAs as questions. Every step has ONE ask.
Aureon positioning: Performance Partner, Quality Converts, Limited Intake, 30/70 commission split, only pay on close.
Real case study numbers — Munich (3 agents, 9→17/mo, +89%, +€192k/yr) and Amsterdam (6 agents, 22%→34% close, +€340k yr1).
Light HTML, plain prose body — the renderer (sequences/email_render.py) wraps it with the gold-accent template + bottom logo.

step_authoring_guide.where: This file. Each object in `variants` defines one step.

fields.n: Step number 1..7 — matches step_n in the runtime sequence.
fields.delay_days: Days after the PREVIOUS step (step 1 is always 0).
fields.angle: Free-text label so you remember what the step does.
fields.subject: Subject line. May contain merge fields.
fields.body: Plain prose. \n\n separates paragraphs. Renderer adds signature + Aureon logo + unsubscribe footer; do NOT include them here.

variants.subject: 5 to 10 more closings this quarter
variants.body:
Hi {first_name},

Quick one. We help real estate teams close 5 to 10 more deals per quarter without spending another dollar on marketing.

Here is the deal: we run the lead generation, our team takes the first call, qualifies the prospect, and only hands you people who are ready to talk listings. You only pay when a deal closes. 30 percent of commission to us, 70 percent stays with you. No retainer, no setup fees, no nothing if zero deals close.

Real numbers from our work: one team in Munich went from 9 to 17 closed deals per month, an extra 192 thousand euros in their first year. A 6 agent brokerage in Amsterdam moved their close rate from 22 percent to 34 percent and added 340 thousand euros in year one.

We are taking two US pilot teams this quarter. After that the slots are closed until next quarter.

If you have room for more closings, worth 15 minutes to see if you qualify?

variants.subject: would you take 5 free closings
variants.body:
Hi {first_name},

Buried by now. I will keep it short.

If I put 5 qualified, pre-screened seller appointments on your calendar this month, and you only paid if a deal closed, would you take that call?

That is the offer. 30 percent of commission only on closes. Compare that to a marketing agency: 3 to 8 thousand dollars per month, no guarantee, leads still unqualified when they hit your inbox.

We close that loop. Worth 15 minutes?

variants.subject: the 5 minute rule (your close rate triples)
variants.body:
Hi {first_name},

One number runs our entire model.

When you respond to a fresh lead in under 5 minutes, your close rate roughly triples versus the industry average response time of 47 minutes. Most agents lose the deal in the first hour without ever knowing.

We close that gap. Our team picks up the phone in under 5, qualifies, books the appointment, hands the warm lead to you. You spend your time on the listings that matter.

What is your team's current average response time to a new lead? If it is anywhere north of 15 minutes, that is the cheapest revenue you have not collected yet.

variants.subject: how 6 agents added 340k in year one
variants.body:
Hi {first_name},

Real numbers from our brokerage in Amsterdam last year.

Before us: 6 agents, close rate 22 percent on inbound, average response time 51 minutes, 0 percent of deal flow from inbound.

After 12 months with us: close rate 34 percent. Response time under 5 minutes. Inbound is now 40 percent of total deal flow. Revenue added in year one: 340 thousand euros. Same team, same listings, same effort. The leads stopped leaking.

Not promising the same numbers for {city} blindly. The setup is repeatable. Worth a 15 minute call to map it onto {company} and see what is realistic for you?

variants.subject: more leads or more closes
variants.body:
Hi {first_name},

Real question, takes 30 seconds.

If I gave you the choice between (a) twice as many leads, or (b) the same leads but double the close rate, which one are you picking?

For every team I have talked to this year, the answer is (b). And that is the exact problem we solve. Same lead flow, way better closes.

If that is your situation, reply 'b' and I will send you the pilot scope. If it is (a) for you, I will save us both the time.

variants.subject: 60 day pilot, 0 dollars down, 2 slots left
variants.body:
Hi {first_name},

The most risk-free version I can write you.

60 day pilot. You pick 1 or 2 zip codes. We bring qualified seller appointments inside 5 minutes of every lead. 30 percent of commission only on deals that close inside the 60 days. If no deals close, you owe zero and we both walk away. No retainer, no setup, no contract beyond the pilot.

We are taking 2 pilot teams in the US this quarter. After this quarter the slots close until next year because we cap intake. Quality converts. Volume does not.

Want the pilot scope for {company}, or pass for now?

variants.subject: last one from me
variants.body:
Hi {first_name},

Wrapping up.

If this is not the quarter, no hard feelings. If you ever want to revisit, a one word reply ("later") is enough and I will check in next quarter.

If this was the wrong angle entirely, fair enough. Best of luck on the rest of {city} this year.
